blurb:
WE PRESENT 12 PARLOUR SHOWS EVERY WEEK—THIS IS NOT ONE OF THEM.

SHOOT OGAWA: UP CLOSE, AFTER DARK is a highly unusual, infrequently offered experience created for an exceptionally small audience. Limited to only 20 guests, this exclusive adults-only event places you around the table, just inches from world-champion sleight-of-hand artist Shoot Ogawa.

There is no distant stage and nowhere for the impossible to hide. You see every movement up close. The magic unfolds before your eyes—and even happens in your hands.

Inside an atmospheric Victorian-inspired setting at Hilton Waikiki Beach, astonishing illusions, sharp comedy, and immersive storytelling come together in a performance that feels intensely personal, spontaneous, and impossible.

This is not your standard parlor show. It is a rare, after-dark encounter available on select occasions for guests ages 18 and over.

Only 20 seats. One table. No ordinary night of magic.

Come closer. Take your seat. Experience the impossible.
